summary: All 3,564 genes with matching Entrez IDs and complete probe sets agreed in direction between Greenwood et al.’s Table S1 and the registered salt-loading result. They covered 62.32% of the 5,719 identifiable selected genes, below the 90% author-concordance-v2 requirement. The comparison reproduced byte-for-byte, and the proposal passed the repository validator. [Primary workbook](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/files/S-EPMC4386000/9016251045f6927940162e8533b81f37_tableS1-S6.xlsx)
openIssues: Table S1 contains only BH-selected probes. Full verification would require the unfiltered GeneSpring results.
Among 3,079 comparable single-probe genes, all passed author BH < 0.05 and 2,997 passed registered BH < 0.05. Author gene-level P and FDR remain unassessed for the 485 matched multi-probe genes.
